verdict.rationale: Working Copy has an automation surface (an x-callback-url scheme) and a Repository Agent, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. However, its own URL-scheme documentation explicitly states there is "no test mode", and nothing in the pack describes a sandbox environment isolated from production data. Local commits that are not yet pushed are an adjacent git workflow, not a product-provided sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
